text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To put it simply, the answer is the spot 
you reach after walking "1.6 laps 
clockwise, 2.4 laps counter-clockwise, and 
2 laps clockwise" around this observation 
deck!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The hint is—the information from the hotel 
map that Fine-san remembered for us♪

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I don't really get it, but we just 
need to search that spot, right? Come on, 
Rice-chan, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Ah, Urara-chan, the first one is 
clockwise!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, Urara-san. Please be careful not 
to trip and fall.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Well, while we leave the item searching to 
those two, would you mind explaining that 
last deduction to me?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I would love to hear it as well. The 
clue's instruction was to trace the peaks 
of maidens—in other words, "trace the 
Triple Tiara," correct?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes. But we can't actually travel to the 
racecourses, nor can we run the full race 
distances here.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That was where what Fine-san remembered 
gave me the hint—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No, but they showed me a floor map when we 
arrived at the hotel.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, it said, "A 100m-perimeter 
observation corridor at a height of 250m. 
Please enjoy the 360-degree panoramic 
view!" or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
When I heard that, it caught my attention 
that one lap around the deck was exactly 
100 meters. And there were numbers that 
caught our eye in the riddle too, right?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"In the corridor high above the heavens, 
10 becomes 1 and 100 becomes 10." In this 
observation deck, both numbers become 
1/10th. In other words—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't we assume that we just need to 
scale down the distances of each Triple 
Tiara race to 1/10th, and circle around 
clockwise or counter-clockwise according 
to the track layout?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
I see. For the Oka Sho, 1,600m becomes 
160m, following Hanshin Racecourse's 
clockwise direction. If you trace each 
race like that, at that exact spot—!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh~? We went all the way around, but 
there's nothing here~?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-What should we do...? Did Rice and Urara 
do something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. It seems they are having 
trouble, so I will go assist them.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"If I am not mistaken, it appears the 
counterclockwise distance run was 
insufficient for both of you. Let us do it 
once more together."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Aha, you really pay attention to your 
surroundings, Ikuno-san. Curren can't help 
but want to rely on you♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. She's so dependable, isn't she? 
...Hey, Curren-chan. May I ask you another 
question?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Why... didn't you stop the three of them?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"You said you wanted to take this audition 
seriously, right, Curren-chan?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
To take on the challenge for Beauty-san's 
universe-best "cute" racewear, 
don't you agree there couldn't be a more 
"serious" team than this?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"There is a time limit. There are rival 
teams. 
And yet, despite being 'serious', you 
didn't choose efficiency."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Even without going out of your way to run 
every single distance, you should have 
known the location indicated by the 
riddle... That's why I'm wondering."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Because what Curren wants is a truly 
'cute' racing outfit.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Truly... 'cute'?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Yes♪ Certainly, if our only priority was 
solving it quickly, it might have been 
faster for Curren to just tell everyone 
the location."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"But getting flustered all on my own in a 
team match, or pouring cold water on my 
teammates' hard work... That's just 'not 
cute' in Curren's book."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"A racing outfit made from watching an 
'uncute' Curren like that wouldn't suit me 
at all, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I see... You're even thinking about what 
aspects of you you want Beauty-san to see, 
Curren-chan."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: That's right. Besides, take a look—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Found it~! We found it this time!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodness... Now we can take on the 
next riddle!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Good work, both of you. 
Let us join forces and conquer the 'Second 
Riddle' as well!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"—Everyone has their own kind of 
'cuteness'... 
I thought it would be such a waste if she 
didn't get to see that♪"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I wonder what this stick is used 
for?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"While its shape is quite distinctive, its 
purpose remains unclear. 
Perhaps it will become evident as we solve 
the riddles?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"The next problem looks tough too, 
though... 
Um, Rice will read it!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"'In the room where all numbers gather, 
look up to find the treasure. 
The beginning of a legend: on your mark.'"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: What mark are we supposed to get on?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Just like the last riddle, I think this 
clue wants us to deduce the location of 
the room from the text, but..."

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"'—Bonjour, it's Beauty Anshinzawa! 
Looks like every team is making great 
progress on their riddles!'"

text_block_list.name: Beauty Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"'However, it's time for a little break♪ 
Everyone, please gather in the main 
hall!'"
